notes:
What's new in EnigmaCast

Faster and more reliable zapping on satellite channels, with fewer green or noisy pictures on some Android TV boxes. Subtitles stay off by default. SD channels scale better. Pause is disabled on live TV with picture because there is no timeshift. New OpenPLi skin with a classic Enigma2-style channel list: OK opens the list; colour keys open bouquets, EPG, guide and options.

companion.notes: Live koppelt nu automatisch met de Enigma2-ontvanger van de TV. Nieuw: Zoeken en een Torrents-tab als die op de TV aanstaat.
